name: julia-api
title: Julia JSON API
blurb: Julia JSON service on HTTP.jl: pure request contract, Test suite with a real-socket case, no hand-written HTTP parsing
default_description: A Julia JSON web service on HTTP.jl.

verify.name: http
verify.cmd: if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5422/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'port 5422 is already serving something else - stop it before running this step'; exit 1; fi; PORT=5422 julia --project=. src/main.jl > .julia.log 2>&1 & server=$!; ready=1; for _ in $(seq 1 240); do if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5422/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=0; break; fi; sleep 0.5; done; if [ "$ready" != 0 ]; then cat .julia.log; echo 'the server did not answer'; kill $server 2>/dev/null || true; wait $server 2>/dev/null || true; exit 1; fi; kill -0 $server 2>/dev/null || { cat .julia.log; echo 'the server exited before it answered'; exit 1; }; health=$(curl -fsS --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:5422/health); got=$(curl -fsS --max-time 10 'http://127.0.0.1:5422/stats?text=hello%20world%0A'); posted=$(curl -fsS --max-time 10 -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary '{"text":"a b\nc\n"}' http://127.0.0.1:5422/stats); missing=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:5422/stats); broken=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 10 -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary '{not json' http://127.0.0.1:5422/stats); gone=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:5422/nope); kill $server 2>/dev/null || true; wait $server 2>/dev/null || true; test "$health" = '{"status":"ok"}'; echo "$got" | grep -q '"lines":1'; echo "$got" | grep -q '"bytes":12'; echo "$posted" | grep -q '"words":3'; test "$missing" = 422; test "$broken" = 422; test "$gone" = 404
